parsed.summary: The PR addresses the alias conflict issue during QuerySet OR operations and improves maintainability by adding comments and handling alias prefix conflicts more robustly.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new parameter `exclude` in the `bump_prefix` method, which is a minor change in the API.
The PR adds a comment explaining the purpose of the assertion in `change_aliases`, which improves documentation.
